name: Curriculum graph
description: A page that draws the courses of a curriculum as a graph by semester, with prerequisites, co-requisites, hand-offs and other relations, the details of each course and the evidence of each relation. Problems and comments are marked on the graph and members add, answer and resolve them there. The graph comes from the project's harness (schema curriculum-graph/1) and everything is kept as records of the hub.
